meta.note: Quarterly figures as reported by each company. MU (fiscal year ends late Aug) and NVDA (fiscal year ends late Jan) use company fiscal quarters; GOOG, ETN, GEV use calendar quarters. Each series is plotted against its own period end date so cross-company comparison uses actual calendar time.

sources.MU: Perplexity Finance company financials (income statement), sourced from company 10-Q/10-K/earnings releases
sources.NVDA: Perplexity Finance company financials (income statement), sourced from company 10-Q/10-K/earnings releases
sources.GOOG: Perplexity Finance company financials + segment/KPI data (Google Cloud revenue, Revenue Backlog), sourced from Alphabet 10-Q/10-K/earnings releases
sources.ETN: Perplexity Finance company financials (total revenue) + segment revenue; orders/backlog researched separately from Eaton earnings press releases
sources.GEV: Perplexity Finance company financials + segment/KPI data (orders, RPO by segment), sourced from GE Vernova 10-Q/10-K/earnings releases
